Printing technologist/-login 100%, on site | Manufacture Horlogère Suisse | ETA SA

Mansioni
- Printing technologist/-login 100%, on site
- Your future tasksContact person for production in the field of digital printing
- Project support for the introduction of new digital printing presses
- Commissioning of machines and software as well as accompanying the introduction to production
- Creation of user documentation, such as maintenance plans, operating instructions and training materials
- Implementation of training courses for employees in the field of digital printing
- Responsibility for continuous improvements and coordination of appropriate measures
- Preparation and configuration of RIP software for production operations
- Support of the development department for new developments
- Main contact for color management

Requirements
Completed vocational training as a print technologist/login EFZ or media technologist/login EFZ
Sound experience in digital printing or in 4-color printing
- Strong technical understanding and high quality awareness
- Very good PC knowledge, especially when dealing with RIP software
Good color vision and in-depth knowledge of color management (CMS)
- You can expect a versatile and demanding activity in day-to-day operations, which requires a high degree of independence and personal responsibility.
— Apply
You have fluent knowledge of German, English and/or French is an advantage

Cosa of Friamo
- An exciting working environment in a company that is constantly evolving and offers numerous advantages:
- Various opportunities for further education
- In-house mobility with attractive career prospects
- Five or six weeks of vacation per year (depending on age and/or function)
- 40-hour week according to GAV
- Attractive wage policy and good social benefits
- Three weeks of parental leave for fathers and up to 19 weeks for mothers
- Company restaurant
Discounts on products of the Swatch Group and other partner companies
- Sports activities and corporate events
Participation in health insurance
